decisive_items: reduced diffusion in the spinal cord white matter
missing_items: explicit mention of ligamentous disruptions (anterior longitudinal ligament, ligamentum flavum)
direct reference to the mechanism of trauma
response.rationale: R3 integrates clinical syndrome, traumatic imaging findings, and diffusion abnormality, fully matching the acute spinal cord injury context. R1 captures only the compression, lacking the clinical and diffusion evidence.

rejected.why: Fracture alone fails to explain spinal cord injury and diffusion restriction.
Acute transverse myelitis would not present with ligamentous disruptions and anterolisthesis; traumatic cause is more likely.
Hypothermia is a consequence, not the primary diagnosis.
Spondylolisthesis is part of the imaging but not the complete clinical syndrome; no raw support spans.
